title: Axion EFT in the BMHV Scheme: Flavor Currents, Evanescent Operators and Ward Identities
summary: We present a systematic analysis of axion effective field theory within the Breitenlohner-Maison-`t Hooft-Veltman (BMHV) scheme, focusing on the renormalization of fermionic dimension-five operators and the associated chiral flavor currents. In this framework, the non-anticommuting nature of $γ_5$ in $d \neq 4$ dimensions leads to violations of naive Ward identities through the emergence of evanescent operators.
